_meta.name: flux1-persephone-instantx-ip-adapter
_meta.purpose: Character multi-view generation using Persephone (Flux.1) + InstantX IP-Adapter via Shakker-Labs/ComfyUI-IPAdapter-Flux node. Uses standard ComfyUI samplers — no custom sampler hacks. Works on Apple Silicon MPS. Takes a front-view reference image and generates a new view of the same character.
editable: 87.inputs.text (positive prompt — describe the new view/pose, keep identity blurb verbatim)
25.inputs.noise_seed (set to 0 for random seed each run)
17.inputs.steps (default 25 for IP-Adapter; can go to 20 for speed)
79.inputs.end_percent (when IP-Adapter stops — try 0.8 to reduce noise artifacts)
tips: Uses Shakker-Labs ComfyUI-IPAdapter-Flux (InstantX IP-Adapter) — NOT the broken XLabs x-flux-comfyui
Works with standard ComfyUI samplers on MPS — no XlabsSampler needed
Set end_percent to 0.8 if you get noise artifacts at high weight
weight 0.75 is a good starting point — higher = tighter consistency, lower = more creative freedom
Uses SigLIP vision encoder (auto-downloaded from HuggingFace), not CLIP ViT-L
Only 128 IP-Adapter tokens — lightweight cross-attention, no MPS crash risk
Keep identity/wardrobe/lighting prompt sections identical to reference, change only pose/view

architecture.model: Persephone (Flux.1) — uncensored, higher base quality than Klein
architecture.conditioning: InstantX IP-Adapter via ComfyUI-IPAdapter-Flux (model patcher, not block replacement)
architecture.tradeoff: Better image quality vs weaker identity consistency than Flux.2 native conditioning

inputs.text: A full-body character sheet, side view, three-quarter angle, wide angle full-length shot from head to toe. A hyper-realistic athletic woman with a sharp jawline and intense eyes. She has a highly defined, toned physique with visible abdominal muscles and muscular thighs. Sun-kissed skin with visible pores. Standing in a relaxed contrapposto pose. Full anatomical nudity, detailed muscular and pelvic anatomy. Plain white background, studio lighting, 8k, highly detailed. Shot on 35mm lens, wide field of view.
